info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Loan Management API
info.description: The Corporate Loan Management API provides functionalities for retrieving detailed information about corporate loan products. This endpoint allows developers to access essential data related to corporate lending options offered by the bank, including interest rates, terms, and eligibility criteria. It is particularly useful for financial institutions, businesses seeking loan products, and developers integrating banking solutions into their platforms. The API aims to enhance decision-making processes by providing quick access to critical loan information.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed information about corporate loans offered under the deposit lending service, including applicable terms, interest rates, and eligibility criteria.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving corporate loan details in the deposit lending context. This request should be structured according to the specified schema and must include all required parameters to ensure accurate response.

200.description: Successful retrieval of corporate loan information.
